editorial:
Two driven students, Sojin and Hyeyoung, turn a scholarship exam into a tense but playful rivalry, and their constant checking on each other slowly reveals feelings neither wants to admit. The movie keeps things light, fast, and charming, with bright campus energy, quick banter, and a sweet romantic pull that makes the competition feel personal instead of mean. You will enjoy the easy chemistry and the way small moments build into bigger emotions, especially when pride gets in the way of honesty.

The performances feel natural, the pacing rarely drags, and the humor lands without trying too hard. Some scenes are predictable, and the romance could use more depth, but the fun tone keeps you invested from start to finish. If you like breezy romantic comedies with rivals-to-lovers energy, this is a cozy pick for a relaxed night.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the exam pressure peaks and both Sojin and Hyeyoung realize their rivalry has become something deeper. After a last-minute misunderstanding, one of them makes a bold move to confess instead of competing. The twist is that the scholarship result matters less than their choice to support each other, and they walk away as a couple with a playful promise to keep challenging one another.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves campus romance and rivals-to-lovers stories.
